description: This file defines a simple linear congruential pseudo-random number generator (PRNG) with functions for generating random numbers within specified ranges, supporting multi-threaded safety via atomic operations. It includes internal constants, inline functions for state progression, and public API functions for range-based random number generation.

methods.name: prng_state_next_u32
methods.description: Calculates the next 32-bit PRNG state based on the current state.

methods.name: prng_state_next_u64
methods.description: Calculates the next 64-bit PRNG state based on the current state.

methods.name: prng_state_next_zu
methods.description: Calculates the next size_t PRNG state based on the current state, supporting different pointer sizes.

methods.name: prng_lg_range_u32
methods.description: Generates a uniform random number in [0, 2^lg_range) for 32-bit states, thread-safe if atomic is true.

methods.name: prng_lg_range_u64
methods.description: Generates a uniform random number in [0, 2^lg_range) for 64-bit states.

methods.name: prng_lg_range_zu
methods.description: Generates a uniform random number in [0, 2^lg_range) for size_t states, supporting atomic operations.

methods.name: prng_range_u32
methods.description: Generates a uniform random number in [0, range) for 32-bit states.

methods.name: prng_range_u64
methods.description: Generates a uniform random number in [0, range) for 64-bit states.

methods.name: prng_range_zu
methods.description: Generates a uniform random number in [0, range) for size_t states.
